Press through heels and contract glutes hard to lift hips toward ceiling.

Hold peak contraction for a deliberate 2-count.
Lower hips smoothly until glutes lightly tap the mat, then repeat.
Take a controlled step forward with lead leg.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor and back knee hovers an inch above ground.
Maintain upright torso and tight core.
Drive through front heel to step forward into next stride.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.
Initiate movement by sending hips back and bending knees.

Keep heels glued to the floor and spine neutral.
Drive through heels and mid-foot to return to full extension.
Rest rear foot on sturdy chair or elevation.
Lower rear knee toward floor in a controlled vertical path.
Keep front foot flat and knee tracking over second toe.
Press through front mid-foot and heel to return upright.
Lie flat on back, cross one ankle over opposite knee.
Reach through and pull thigh toward chest.
Keep head and shoulders relaxed on mat.
Breathe deeply into hip tension for 45 seconds each side.
